name: L1 Core: conventions, handles, clock, input, logging
body: Port `core` and `platform`: math conventions, generational handles and pools, the fixed-step clock, input actions and bindings, colours and logging. `PlatformBackend` and `AudioSink` become Nox interfaces.

comments.text: Ported on the L1 PR: 25 Rust tests plus a check that log lines match the Rust logger's format, 27 of 27 passing on the native and C backends. The nox test task waits on nox-systems-language #4 merging. Nox gaps found, each on the Nox board under proto-nox-prototype-compiler/proto-lantern-engine-on-nox with the interim Lantern uses: proto-struct-values-in-constants, proto-the-remainder-operator-on-floats, proto-printing-to-standard-error, proto-generic-methods-on-structs-and-classes, proto-static-members-of-generic-structs, proto-formatted-panic-messages, proto-comparing-an-optional-with-a-value, proto-arrays-of-enums-whose-payloads-own.
Lantern #15 merged into nox-proto (894a5c7) after review; nox-systems-language #4 merged into proto (102cd7d).

acceptance_criteria.text: `core`'s 25 Rust tests pass as `nox test` programs

definition_of_done.text: PR into `nox-proto`, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
